{"id": "662fece6-0fd6-41e6-a56a-5a510caa2c6f", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Your account has 18 knowledge bases, so I haven't picked one to inspect yet. Here's what to check, roughly in order.

**1. Did the last sync work? (the stale answers)**
- Look at the most recent ingestion job on each data source. Check its status (`COMPLETE`, `FAILED` or `STOPPED`) and its statistics: documents scanned, new, modified, deleted and failed.
- Read the job's failure reasons. Common ones are:
  - the service role can't read the S3 bucket or decrypt with the KMS key
  - files are an unsupported format or too large
  - the vector store is unreachable, throttled or missing
  - the embedding model was changed or can't be accessed
- A job that is `COMPLETE` with many failed documents still leaves content stale. Those files are skipped silently.
- Check that syncs actually run. A Bedrock knowledge base doesn't re-sync on its own. Something has to call `StartIngestionJob`, such as an EventBridge schedule, a Lambda function or a pipeline. If that trigger failed or was removed, the data just ages.
- Confirm the source has the updated files, including the right prefix and inclusion filters.
- Check the data source's deletion policy (`DELETE` or `RETAIN`). It decides whether removed documents leave the index.

**2. Why exact part numbers retrieve poorly**
- Pure semantic (vector) search handles identifiers like `AB-4471-X` badly. Embeddings capture meaning, not exact strings.
- Switch the retrieval `overrideSearchType` to `HYBRID` so keyword matching is combined with vector search. This only works on supported vector stores such as OpenSearch Serverless or Aurora PostgreSQL.
- Check the chunking strategy. Part-number tables chopped mid-row, or chunks that are too large or too small, dilute matches. Try smaller chunks or hierarchical chunking. Keep the part number in the same chunk as its description.
- Use metadata filters on structured fields such as SKU or category instead of relying on the text match.
- Add a reranker, and consider normalizing part-number formats (dashes, spaces, case) at ingestion and in queries.
- If you recently changed embedding models or chunking, re-ingest everything. Vectors from different embedding models in one index will rank poorly.

**3. Confirm the app queries the right place**
- Check that the app uses the knowledge base ID, data source and alias you expect, and that no cache or old index sits in front of it.

If you tell me which knowledge base this is, I can pull its data sources and recent ingestion jobs and tell you what the last sync did.", "type": "text"}, {"id": "tooluse_9RmrF742S693HUnbOnNKsk", "tool_name": "ask_user", "input": {"question": "Which knowledge base should I check?", "options": [{"label": "llmops-demo-product-kb", "description": "Product knowledge base, most likely to hold part numbers"}, {"label": "llmops-lf-kb-skus", "description": "SKU-focused knowledge base"}, {"label": "llmops-lf-kb-stale", "description": "Knowledge base whose name suggests stale data"}, {"label": "llmops-lf-kb-web", "description": "Web-sourced knowledge base"}]}, "type": "tool_use"}], "created_at": null}
